facts.text: The Penn State Behrend campus was donated to the University in 1948 by Mary Behrend in memory of her husband Ernst, co-founder of the Hammermill Paper Company.

sources.title: College History | Penn State Behrend
sources.quote: The Penn State Behrend campus was donated to the University in 1948 by Mary Behrend in memory of her husband, Ernst, co-founder (with his father and brother) of the Hammermill Paper Company

facts.text: In 1973, the Penn State Board of Trustees granted four-year college and graduate status to Penn State Behrend, making it the first Penn State location outside University Park to achieve that status.

sources.title: College History | Penn State Behrend
sources.quote: On January 20, 1973, the Penn State Board of Trustees granted four-year college and graduate status to Penn State Behrend, making it the first Penn State location outside of University Park to achieve such status.

facts.text: Penn State Behrend's Open Lab approach to learning pairs students and faculty experts with business and industry partners in Knowledge Park.

sources.title: Behrend's Open Lab Opportunities and Enrollment Expand | Penn State Behrend
sources.quote: The expansion of Knowledge Park will advance Behrend's Open Lab approach to learning, which pairs students and faculty experts with business and industry partners.
